title: Synchronize invariant probes through an owned boundary
trigger: event observer test synchronization manifest mutation fixture timing CI
guidance: Drive deliberate state changes in invariant tests through a synchronous host-owned seam. Assert the mutation occurred after the pinned planning surface and before dispatch. Agentica event sinks are best-effort observers; their bounded or detached delivery cannot establish that a mutation happened before execution. Test observer delivery and failure behavior separately, and retain the original refusal and zero-effect assertions when correcting a scheduling-dependent probe.

evidence.note: Observer delivery is explicitly best-effort. Runner dispatch separately recompiles and checks the pinned tool manifest.

All 33 focused tests passed locally after moving the mutation into the planner callback. Explicit old/new hash, mutation, refused receipt and zero-call assertions remain. The same source was included in admitted PR39 head a03e20c and passing Windows/Linux run41666172418.

recheck: Reinspect the current event and dispatch contracts when reliable execution hooks or manifest custody change. This development lesson is not runtime authority or a substitute for a current invariant test.
